surfaces.name: App shell, routing and page chrome
surfaces.job: Move between feed, own catches, sites and gear, start a log, and reach account controls (sign in, avatar menu, profile, light/dark) from any screen.
surfaces.today:
- Render tree: StrictMode > ClerkProvider (publishableKey only, no appearance) > BrowserRouter > App + one global Toaster (main.tsx:15-27, Toaster at :24).
- 14 routes in one flat table, no gear detail route, `*` becomes Navigate to `/` replace (App.tsx:20-34).
- No layout route, no Outlet, no route-level auth guard: 13 pages each mount their own chrome.
- Repeated page template: div.min-h-screen > LandingHeader > main.mx-auto flex w-full max-w-4xl flex-col gap-6 px-4 py-8, first child FishingActionBar (e.g. MyCatchesPage.tsx:87-91, FeedPage.tsx:285-288).
- Header: sticky top-0 z-40 border-b, inner mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 py-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8, about 69px tall (LandingHeader.tsx:16-17).
- Header contents: lucide Fish brand mark + text 'Fullstack AI Angler' to `/` (:18-26); md+ links Profile (signed-in only) /profile, Features, Use cases, FAQ as plain `<a href='/#...'>` (:8-12, :29-36); theme toggle; Clerk SignInButton modal 'Sign in' or UserButton avatar (:54); mobile-only ghost icon Button, lucide Menu, aria-label 'Open navigation menu' (:63-67).
- Mobile (<768px): text nav hidden, fixed bottom tab bar + FAB, body reserves pb-24 = 96px (index.css:122). md+: text nav shows, bottom bar hides, dock fixed top-[5.25rem], 96px in-flow spacer, body md:pb-0.
- Header container max-w-6xl (1152px) vs page content max-w-4xl (896px).
- ProfilePage: own layout, max-w-6xl px-4 py-10, no FishingActionBar at all (ProfilePage.tsx:9-11).
- HomePage: full landing page then FishingActionBar inside section.max-w-6xl px-4 pb-16 (HomePage.tsx:6-10).
- Stacking: header z-40, dock and tab bar z-40, Toaster z-50, dialog overlay and content z-50.
- Shell data: Clerk session only (`<Show when=...>`); theme in localStorage['theme'] = 'light' | 'dark' with matchMedia prefers-color-scheme fallback (LandingThemeToggle.tsx:8-21). No app data fetched at shell level.
- index.html: `<title>client</title>` (:7), favicon /vite.svg (:5, only file in public/); no meta description, theme-color, manifest, apple-touch-icon or font links.
- Header visual: border-b border-border/60 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-xl supports-[backdrop-filter]:bg-background/60; brand mark rounded-xl bg-primary/15 p-2 text-primary shadow-sm shadow-primary/30; Sign in shadow-sm shadow-primary/30; toggle rounded-full border-primary/30 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur.
- Landing root carries a radial sky glow, rgba(56,189,248,0.12) (LandingPage.tsx:9); app page wrappers have none.
- Motion: html scroll-behavior smooth (index.css:126-128), header links transition-colors hover:text-foreground, instant route changes, global `* { border-border; outline-ring/50 }` (index.css:118-120). No footer, breadcrumbs, back link or page-title bar on app pages.
surfaces.broken:
- About 150px of permanent top chrome on desktop: sticky ~69px header plus a separate fixed dock at top 84px, content scrolls underneath both (FishingActionBar.tsx:26).
- Every app page's header shows marketing anchors (Features, Use cases, FAQ) that do full navigations back to the landing page, while real app destinations live only in the dock (LandingHeader.tsx:8).
- Mobile hamburger has no onClick and no menu or sheet behind it: dead control (LandingHeader.tsx:63).
- /profile is unreachable on phones: the only Profile link is inside `hidden md:flex` nav (LandingHeader.tsx:29-36).
- App nav is mounted on the marketing home page for signed-out visitors; dock floats over the hero and the desktop spacer renders below the footer (HomePage.tsx:9).
- ProfilePage has no app nav yet body pb-24 still reserves 96px of empty space on mobile (ProfilePage.tsx:10, index.css:122).
- Header max-w-6xl and content max-w-4xl do not share a left edge on wide screens (LandingHeader.tsx:17).
- Missing VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY throws before render: blank page, no message (main.tsx:11-13).
- Auth gating inconsistent: MyCatches/MySites/MyGear/EditGear render only a signed-in branch (signed-out users get chrome over a blank page); CatchDetail, SiteDetail, EditCatch, EditSite and Home have no gate (App.tsx:20-34).
- Unknown URLs silently redirect to `/`; there is no 404 screen (App.tsx:34).
- Signing in or out on a page refetches nothing: every data effect runs once on mount and ignores auth state. My lists keep 'No catches found.' (MyCatchesPage.tsx:49-64), Log catch keeps empty option lists, Edit gear keeps spinning (EditGearPage.tsx:39-59), Feed shows Follow on the angler's own posts.
- Signing out on Edit catch or Edit site leaves the filled form on screen (no gate).
- Scroll is never reset on route change (main.tsx:22): opening a detail page from a scrolled list, or saving from the bottom of Log catch, lands mid-page; global smooth scroll animates any restoration (index.css:126-128).
- document.title is never set anywhere in src, so every route shows 'client' in the tab and in bookmarks.
- No in-page back link on any page; every post-save redirect pushes a history entry (LogCatchPage.tsx:278, LogSitePage.tsx:48, EditCatchPage.tsx:218, EditSitePage.tsx:108, LogGearPage.tsx:44, EditGearPage.tsx:84) so Back returns to the form; only Profile replaces.
- Back trap: a bad gear id redirects with a pushed entry (EditGearPage.tsx:48), so Back from /gear/me re-enters the bad URL and pushes /gear/me again, looping.
- No skip link, focus is never moved on navigation, and FishingActionBar is the first child of `<main>` on 12 pages, so on mobile the bottom tab bar comes before the page h1 for keyboard and screen-reader users (LogCatchPage.tsx:359).
- Three navigation landmarks (header nav, desktop dock, mobile tab bar) have no aria-label; two `<nav>` elements sit inside `<main>` (FishingActionBar.tsx:26, :54).
- Theme class is applied in an effect after first paint with no pre-paint script, so dark-preference users get a light flash on every load (LandingThemeToggle.tsx:26-29).
- Toasts follow you across pages: module-level store, so an error from a page just left shows for 4.5s on the next page (use-toast.ts:9-25). StrictMode also double-fires effects in dev (duplicate location prompts, stacked identical toasts, main.tsx:16).
surfaces.keep: The route shapes and URL vocabulary (App.tsx:20-34). A persistent sticky header carrying brand, theme toggle and auth cluster on every screen. One global Toaster mounted once (main.tsx:24). Theme preference read from localStorage with a prefers-color-scheme fallback (LandingThemeToggle.tsx:8-21). Mobile-first assumption: bottom nav plus safe-area handling, and a single centred content column with a consistent gap-6 rhythm. Clerk modal sign-in and UserButton avatar menu as the account entry points.

surfaces.broken:
- Mobile navigation has no 'Log site' and no 'Add gear' entry at all; those actions exist only on desktop (:6-21).
- Neither variant links to `/` (home) or `/profile`.
- Naming drifts between breakpoints: desktop 'My locations' (LayoutGrid) is mobile 'Sites' (MapPin), while desktop MapPin means 'Log site' (create).
- The same lucide Plus icon is used for two different actions, 'Log catch' (:14) and 'Add gear' (:18).
- Desktop dock is icon-only: labels appear only in a hover/focus tooltip, and a native `title` puts a second browser tooltip on top of the custom one after a delay (:41-43).
- Create actions and browse destinations are interleaved with no grouping (:13-21).
- The dock never scrolls away and overlaps page content, sitting just under the ~69px sticky header; the 96px spacer only offsets the first paint (:26).
- Mounted on the marketing home page for signed-out visitors: the tab bar and FAB link to auth-gated pages and the desktop spacer renders below the footer (HomePage.tsx:9).
- Not mounted on ProfilePage, so /profile is a dead end with no app nav (ProfilePage.tsx:10).
- Active mobile tab label is 11px text-primary on background, about 3.8:1, failing WCAG AA for small text (:69).
- In dark mode the dock hover pairs near-white foreground with the teal accent background, about 1.9:1 (:37).
- The hover lift and scale probably snap instead of easing: the transition list names `transform` but Tailwind v4's translate/scale utilities animate the separate translate/scale properties (inferred, not browser-verified) (:34).
- Detail and edit URLs such as /catches/123 highlight nothing, because /catches/new and /catches/me are separate prefix-matched items.
- The FAB has no active styling: it stays solid primary even on /catches/new.
- No signed-out variant: signed-out visitors see identical items and are sent to gated pages.
- Both `<nav>` elements are unlabelled and sit inside `<main>`; on mobile the visually-bottom tab bar comes first in DOM order, before the page h1 (:54).
- No reduced-motion handling for the dock magnification (index.css:152).
- Mobile tabs have no pressed state, only transition-colors.
surfaces.keep: The fixed bottom tab bar with a raised centre FAB on mobile, including env(safe-area-inset-bottom) padding (:54). One-tap access to logging a catch from every screen. A single component serving both breakpoints. NavLink-driven active state with aria-current='page'. The four core destinations: feed, my catches, my sites, my gear. Icon plus short label pairing on mobile.

- No `color-scheme` declaration, so native inputs, selects, date pickers, number spinners and scrollbars stay light-styled in dark mode.

- Token-level contrast: light primary-foreground on primary 3.77:1 and primary text on background 3.77:1; white on destructive 4.1:1; dark foreground on accent 1.92:1.
- No prefers-reduced-motion handling anywhere in live CSS (index.css:152): the infinite bobber float and ripple, dock magnification, carousel slide and smooth scrolling all ignore it.
- Dark mode is the light palette with lightness inverted at the same hues (220-244), and the untouched stock shadcn chart-* and sidebar-* tokens remain in the file unused.
- body pb-24 reserves 96px on every mobile page including Profile, which has no tab bar (index.css:122).
- The seven-step radius scale is largely unused: 44+ controls use bare `rounded` (Tailwind's legacy small radius), which matches neither Button (rounded-md) nor Card (rounded-xl).
- index.html ships the Vite defaults: title 'client' (:7) and the /vite.svg favicon (:5), with no theme-color, manifest or apple-touch-icon despite the mobile-first, safe-area-aware layout.
- No brand typeface is loaded; text falls back to SF / Segoe UI / Roboto per platform.
- App.css is imported nowhere (dead Vite starter CSS: #root max-width 1280px, .logo spin keyframe, .read-the-docs #888) and holds the repo's only prefers-reduced-motion rule.
surfaces.keep: Paired light/dark OKLCH token sets under the same names (index.css:48-115) and the cool blue plus teal identity. One --radius driving the whole scale (:8-14). localStorage theme with a system-preference fallback, and a visible toggle in the header. The bobber keyframes as app-specific motion (:130-160). body painting bg-background / text-foreground from tokens. Opacity-modified tokens (border-border/70, bg-primary/15) as the established way to derive tints.

cross_cutting:
Naming: Profile's gallery heading \"Your catches & site images\" is one of seven names the app uses for the same concept (site, fishing site, location, spot, fishing spot, new location, site images), and gear splits again with \"Add gear\" against \"Log catch\" and \"Log site\".

Dates: Profile is the only surface using Intl short format \"Mar 7, 2026\" (ProfileSettingsPanel.tsx:82-86). Catch detail, My catches and site detail use toLocaleString() with seconds, the Feed shows no date at all, and Edit catch shows UTC.

Loaders: the bobber animation is used for the profile load and for uploads, but the connections dialog uses the bare text \"Loading...\", the Feed uses \"Loading feed...\" and weather uses \"(loading...)\". Button busy labels vary across the app (\"Saving...\", \"Getting current location...\", \"Detecting location...\", \"Loading conditions...\").

Load failures: Profile, Feed, My lists, Log catch and Edit gear surface a toast; Catch detail, Site detail, Edit catch and Edit site spin forever. No empty state anywhere in the app offers a call to action, and Profile's gallery sentence is the only one that even hints at a next step.

Empty-image placeholders: five treatments exist (\"No img\", \"No image\", \"No image yet\", \"No images uploaded\", and nothing at all on My gear). R2ImagePicker adds a sixth by showing no placeholder at all.

Confirmations: unfollow uses a styled Radix dialog (FeedPage.tsx:573-611), deleting a catch, site or gear uses the browser's window.confirm, and removing an uploaded image has no confirmation at all.

Dialog primitive: dialog.tsx is shared between the followers dialog and the Feed's unfollow confirm, so the edge-to-edge mobile width, the missing close-button focus style and the inert animation classes affect both.

Post-save destinations: catch and site edits go to the detail page, gear goes to the list, Profile goes to the marketing home. Profile is the only one that replaces the history entry; every other redirect pushes, so Back returns to the form.

Form controls: none of these surfaces use the shadcn Input. Profile wraps raw controls in `label.text-sm`, so typed text inherits 14px medium, while LogSite and the gear pages put labels as siblings and get 16px. Log catch and Edit catch forms diverge further (labels, searchable versus native selects, spinner visibility, submitting state).

Auth refresh: every data effect in the app runs once on mount and ignores auth state, so signing in from the header modal leaves Profile, My lists, Log catch and the Feed showing their signed-out content until a manual refresh.

Toasts: the store is module level (use-toast.ts:9-25), so an error raised on a page just left still shows for 4.5s on the next page. The stack is `fixed right-4 w-full px-4`, which pushes its left edge off-screen on mobile (toaster.tsx:8).

Focus and keyboard: no skip link, focus is never moved on navigation, validation errors are toast-only so focus stays on the submit button, and on the 12 pages that mount FishingActionBar the bottom tab bar is the first child of main, ahead of the h1.

Copy mechanics: plurals are never handled (\"1 catches\", \"Maximum 1 images allowed.\"); toast punctuation varies (\"Image upload complete.\", \"Catch logged!\", \"Gear saved\"); placeholders repeat their own labels elsewhere in the app.

Shape vocabulary: one rounded, bordered, soft-shadowed box repeats at every nesting depth across the whole app, all driven by `--radius: 0.625rem`. Chat and ImageUploader errors break the token system with hard-coded Tailwind palette colours.

Tab titles: document.title is never set anywhere in src, so every route including /profile reads \"client\".
